ios.desc:
Make time for the light around you. Skylight helps you see how much daylight remains and plan a morning walk, a golden hour photo, or a moment outside before sunset.

Explore sun times for your location and date through beautiful, scientifically-accurate charts, Home Screen widgets, and reminders that help you catch the moments you care about.

Follow the changing length of days through the seasons. Look ahead to summer’s long evenings or watch daylight gradually return after the winter solstice.

Available for iPhone, iPad, and Apple Watch.

Features include:
- Follow the sun’s position throughout the day with a fluid visual display.
- Set notifications for daily and yearly sun events.
- Keep daylight in view with three configurable widgets: Year Graph, Daylight Graph, and Gradient.
- Check remaining daylight and upcoming events on your Apple Watch, including directly on your watch face.
- Explore a full year of sun times and seasonal changes in daylight.
- Learn about sun events and discover how their timing changes throughout the year.
- Look up sun times for past and future dates and locations around the world.
- Choose time modes for everyday use, photography, and science.
- Use Siri and Shortcuts to look up sun times, get a daylight summary, and set sun event notifications.

Optional background location updates help keep notifications aligned with your location as you travel.

Skylight is an indie app from the creators of Magic Window. We make beautiful software that helps people connect with the world around them. Questions or suggestions? Contact us at support@jetsoncreative.com.

quotes.story_title: The Eerie Beauty of the Apple Watch Solar Face, and the Anatomy of Nightfall
